#+title: Regenerate a generated file that is in conflict
#+description: The shell recipe inventory is generated; when it conflicts during a rebase, take either side and regenerate it rather than merging it by hand.
#+type: memory
#+memory_subtype: project
#+level: cross
#+filetags: :memory:project:
#+created: 2026-09-26
#+updated: 2026-09-26

A generated file in conflict is resolved by taking either side and re-running its generator, never by editing the conflict by hand, because a hand-merged generated file is wrong in ways no gate compares against.

*Why:* The shell recipe inventory (doc/recipes/shell/shell.org) conflicted on three separate rebases of the same branch, and git could not even parse the hunks on one of them. Taking the upstream side and regenerating it produced the correct file every time, and the inventory gate confirmed it. A capture already exists on main recording the same defect: shell-recipe-inventory-ships-conflict-markers.

*How to apply:* Check out either side, run the generator, verify no conflict markers remain, then stage. ./compass.sh generate rewrites every generated file, the recipe index, the component source lists and the generated code among them. The same rule applies to a component_files.cmake: regenerating beats merging, and the component's #+full_name: is what the script takes, not the directory.
